name: 658. A key with a dollar budget runs one request at a time on a model until an answer on it is priced (unpriced-probe) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7977 billing regression. Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream and its price book. A dollar budget refuses a model for a key once an answer on it priced at $0 (TXE-7957), but that is recorded only when the answer returns, so concurrent requests could each take a $0 answer meanwhile. Until one answer on a row has priced above $0 for a (budget, key), the key now runs one request at a time on it: a concurrent request is refused 429 (type model_pricing_unconfirmed, error_type policy_rate_limited, retry_after_ms 1000). upstream-slow-priced answers after 2s with token usage the price book prices, so the first answer is in flight when the second request arrives, and once it is priced concurrent requests are admitted. [SERIAL]: the rows hold a slow upstream answer.
